name: A Mirror Apart
description:
About This Game

ABOUT THIS GAME

A Mirror Apart is a peaceful isometric puzzle game inspired by infinity mirror rooms.

Guide Kagami through handcrafted worlds where every movement is reflected across multiple spaces. The reflections may move with you, but their surroundings are not always the same. Understanding how each mirrored space connects is the key to solving the puzzles ahead.

MOVE AS ONE

Control Kagami and watch each movement echo through the reflections. What works in one space may lead somewhere entirely different in another, turning every move into part of a larger puzzle.

EXPLORE IMPERFECT REFLECTIONS

Journey through colorful, atmospheric environments built around repetition, symmetry, and subtle differences. Each area introduces new layouts and challenges while expanding on the game's central reflection mechanic.

TAKE YOUR TIME

There are no enemies to fight and no pressure to rush. Explore, experiment, and work through each puzzle at your own pace in a calm world accompanied by an original orchestral soundtrack.

FEATURES

  • Handcrafted isometric puzzles centered around reflections and synchronized movement

  • Simple mouse-driven controls

  • A variety of colorful, atmospheric environments

  • Calm, pressure-free puzzle solving

  • Original orchestral soundtrack

  • A single-player journey through a world of imperfect reflections
short_desc: Explore a world inspired by Infinity Mirror Rooms. Guide Kagami through peaceful, handcrafted isometric puzzles, where every move echoes through imperfect mirrored spaces and each reflection becomes part of the solution.
